summary: Master Process Safety Management with HAZOP, bowtie, MOC, and mechanical integrity tools. Build practical control and reporting skills today.
lede: Process Safety Management training helps professionals identify major accident hazards, manage critical barriers, and sustain safe operations through disciplined standards, procedures, and performance assurance. It connects hazard reviews, operating discipline, change control, and mechanical integrity to the decisions made across maintenance and operations. Through applied workshops, you will build bowtie diagrams, draft management-of-change workflows, create process safety scorecards, and work with action trackers and risk registers. The course also covers pre-startup safety reviews, incident investigation, process safety metrics, and leadership reporting so you can identify control gaps, support safer operating decisions, and strengthen assurance reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is built for professionals who already operate in high-hazard facilities and need a more structured way to control major accident risk, manage barriers, and report process safety performance with credibility. Process Safety Engineers managing barrier integrity and major accident risk. Operations Supervisors controlling safe plant execution and shift discipline. Maintenance and Reliability Engineers supporting mechanical integrity and inspection programs. HSE Managers coordinating PSM assurance, audits, and incident learning. Plant Managers reporting process safety performance to executive leadership. Integrity Specialists tracking equipment health and safety-critical inspections. Production Superintendents balancing throughput with critical control compliance. Contractor Safety Coordinators governing worksite controls for high-hazard tasks. Process Safety Auditors reviewing PSM elements and corrective actions. Engineering Managers approving modifications, PSSR, and operational readiness checks.
modules: Process Safety Management foundations and major accident risk
Hazard analysis with HAZOP and bowtie
Process Safety Management controls and change
Incident learning and process safety metrics
prerequisites: Bring a laptop for workshop exercises and editable templates, plus familiarity with facility documents such as P&IDs, operating procedures, MOC records, inspection logs, or incident reports. Access to a site example or sanitized plant case is helpful for exercises, but the course can also use instructor-provided scenarios and templates. Participants should be prepared to work with practical control documents rather than slide-only discussion.
